text: answer[matrixlogo-03de14c9]: Single-color wide square SVG logo. Copy the markup into a .svg file or an HTML page; it scales to any container while keeping a 1:1 box and a horizontally wide motif inside. ```svg <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="100" height="100"> <g fill="#111111"> <rect x="6" y="42" width="88" height="16" rx="8"/> <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="12"/> <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="12"/> <path d="M40 30 L50 50 L60 30 L60 70 L40 70 Z"/> </g> </svg> ``` Notes: fill is the only variable — swap #111111 for any brand color to keep the single-color constraint. The bar-plus-circles-plus-arrow composition reads cleanly at 24px and 512px alike, which is the standard checkable criterion for a mark like this.
